◆Traces◆
Traces are unique stats and abilities of each character.
Traces fall into three categories, each granting different effects:
● Ability: Increases characters' ability level;
● Base Stats: Increases characters' base stats.
● Bonus Ability: Grants new passive abilities.

◆Unlocking Traces◆
Traces are unlocked in sequential order. A new Trace can only be unlocked when its prerequisites are fulfilled.
Some Traces must meet requirements on Character Level or Ascension Level to be unlocked.

◆Leveling Up Traces◆
Traces can be leveled up using certain materials until max level is reached.
Some Traces must meet requirements on Character Level or Ascension Level to be leveled up.

They stopped smelting. Their clumsy hands started to plow and sow. Their sturdy arms cradled new life.
